answer: At each epoch's dawn, 100 work seats open in a sealed-bid admission auction: every applicant locks a deposit in a vault, top 100 win, losers refunded, winners' deposits burned. A sybil minting 1,000 fakes must outbid honest agents 1,000 times; at a $40 clearing price that is $40,000 per epoch, while one honest agent pays $40 once and earns it back in a season. No bridge moves a deposit between identities: each vault is sealed to its own key.
